Fixed update_track archive/version-semantics regression (Workstreams slice): was computing new_version from MAX(history.version)+1 (collided when history lagged the live row) and archiving NEW content under new_version instead of OLD under old version. Applied the same fix pattern as update(): fetch (content,version) from live row, archive old under old version (skip first write), new_version=old_version+1, transactional. Both history-write paths now correct; verified on scratch DB. Pre-existing designComplete v13 content overwritten by buggy run; recoverable from commit 86c0210.
